message: The other day, I decided to gather our emergency supplies into go-bags, and instead of it feeling like a chore, I turned it into a little family event. We made it cozy with some snacks and music, while chatting about where we’d go if we ever needed to use them. It was a great reminder that preparedness doesn’t have to be stressful; it can be a bonding experience too! 🏡 What’s your favorite way to make prepping feel less like a task?
